rationale: The candidate suggests interlocked atria through layered horizontal pieces and a central opening, but the dominant idea does not hold together consistently across all four views. The isometric views read as overlapping slabs, while the front collapses into a thin stepped stack and the top view shows disconnected fragments rather than a legible nested volume. The void is present but reads more as residual separation than as a clearly framed public courtyard or undercut. The massing also shows likely solid collisions and insufficiently resolved connections, weakening repair integrity. It has limited resonance with stacked-platform and courtyard precedents, but lacks their clear primary mass and controlled hierarchy.
warnings: The form is not coherently legible across all four views.
Solids appear to overlap or collide in the interlocked zones.
The top view reads as separated fragments rather than one nested atrium mass.
The void is not clearly framed as a meaningful public space.
